description: Primary materials establish a live DLUSD custom stablecoin issued through Bridge Open Issuance, 1:1 USD value design, Tempo settlement and Deel-platform exit back to USD value. They do not establish the exact Bridge issuing affiliate for DLUSD, the current token contract or identifier, exact DLUSD cash/Treasury allocation, current custodians for this specific asset, holder legal claim, bankruptcy-remoteness treatment or direct Bridge redemption eligibility for ordinary Deel users.
notes: Do not infer contract identity, statutory trust status, bankruptcy remoteness, exact reserve percentages, complete custodian set or a direct legal redemption right from platform-level Open Issuance documentation.
